description: For every failed KC deduction \(\Gamma\not\vdash_{\mathcal W}A\), take the actual canonical counterworld \(P=\mathsf E(\Gamma\cup\mathcal W,A)\). The specified generated model \((\mathcal C_{\mathcal W})_{\geq P}\) remains a countermodel at \(P\), has \(P\) as its least world, and every pair of its worlds has a common upper bound.
